split_manifest.warmup_usage_rule: All historical transactions in [1.0, train_cutoff_day] enter causal graph construction and model fitting according to supervision rule V0/V1/V2; under D2 (M=30d), [1.0, train_cutoff_day - 30.0] forms the confirmed mature prefix and (train_cutoff_day - 30.0, train_cutoff_day] forms the immature window.
split_manifest.test_interval_semantics: (test_start_day, test_end_day] (left-open, right-closed, 10.0 days, strictly disjoint across blocks 0..7)
